summary: The Department of Travel Industry's map-and-dogwood logo, seen in “This is British Columbia”, published by the Department of Travel Industry of the Province of British Columbia, undated [about 1970]. A supplied vector reconstruction from a photograph of the logo in that book (reference/this_is_british_columbia_logo.png) and a further floral reference. See package-README.md and review/comparison.webp.

assets.sourceLocator: “This is British Columbia”, published by the Department of Travel Industry, undated [about 1970]
assets.dateNote: The book is undated; “about 1970” is its catalogue estimate. The Department of Travel Industry existed from 1967 to 1975.
assets.notes: The province’s outline in green, with a black edge, carrying BRITISH COLUMBIA, two dogwood blossoms on a branch, and “Department of TRAVEL INDUSTRY”. Seen in the Department’s book “This is British Columbia”, about 1970.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the map, the dogwood and 41 hand-authored letters are rebuilt from line segments and Bézier curves after a photograph of the logo in the book, with the flowers redrawn after a closer floral reference (no automatic tracing). Colours are flat approximations of the print. The typeface is not identified.
